items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: Sidney Desvien was instrumental in helping me in that direction... he told me the do's and the don'ts

ctx.x: and he told me the do's and the don'ts narcotics was one don't fool with narcotics yeah and I never did have fool with he told me don't ever fool around with that and be careful you're youngster and you had a long ways to go Sidney Desvien was instrumental in helping me in that direction yeah in fact a lot of guys in the band I was the youngest guy in the band
